description: Prepare a sponsored card for a company's affiliate program. Give the program's page; the card is drafted from the company's own website: its name, a one-line description, logo, brand color and font. Returns the draft and a link where the person sees the card, changes anything, and pays. Nothing is booked or charged until they pay at that link. Never pay, and never enter payment details: pass the link to the person.

programme_url.description: The affiliate, referral or partner program's page. The card links here.

slot.description: The slot wanted, 1 being first. Leave out for the first open one.

subtitle.description: One line about the company, if not the one on the website. Up to 90 characters, no rates or prices.

title.description: The name on the card, if not the one on the website. Up to 32 characters.

website_url.description: The company's own website, if the program page is hosted elsewhere (Tolt, Rewardful, PartnerStack...).

name: submit_ad
title: Prepare a sponsored ad
